articles.titleOriginal: Korea abolishes Prosecutors' Office after 78 years, putting new criminal justice system to test
articles.titleJa: 韓国、78年ぶりに検察庁を廃止、新たな刑事司法制度が試される
articles.summaryJa: 韓国は78年ぶりに最高検察庁を廃止し、捜査権と検察権を分割する新しい機関を立ち上げた。新しい制度では、捜査は重罪捜査機関、警察、上級職員のための汚職捜査局に移行し、検察庁は起訴と法廷起訴を処理します。
articles.summaryOriginal: Korea abolished the Supreme Prosecutors’ Office on Friday after 78 years and launched new agencies that split investigative and prosecutorial powers. The new system shifts investigations to the Serious Crimes Investigation Agency, police and the Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials, while the Prosecution Service handles indictments and court prosecutions. The overhaul raises concerns about overlapping jurisdictions, staffing shortages and whether public safety will improve. Workers remove the Busan District Prosecutors' Office sign from the building in Busan, Wednesday, ahead of the abolition of the Prosecutors’ Office. Newsis
